{{CharInfobox| color={{johto color}} | corecolor={{johto color light}} | bordercolor={{johto color dark}} | name=Mr. Pokémon | jname=ポケモンじいさん| tmname=Old Man Pokémon| image=Mr Pokémon Golden Boys.png | size=200px | caption=Mr. Pokémon in Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys | gender=Male | hometown=Unknown | region=[[Johto]] | game=yes | generation={{Gen|II}} and {{Gen|IV}} | games=[[Pokémon Gold and Silver Versions|Gold, Silver]], {{v2|Crystal}}, [[Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions|HeartGold, SoulSilver]] | footnotes=}} '''Mr. Pokémon''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンじいさん''' ''Old Man Pokémon'') is a [[non-player character]] who lives in a house on {{rt|30|Johto}} in the [[Johto]] [[region]]. He casually researches {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} findings as a hobby, and is old friends with [[Professor Oak]]. He keeps in contact with [[Professor Elm]], as Elm is the authority on Pokémon [[Evolution]]. ==In the core series games== ===Characteristics=== According to Professor Elm, "Mr. Pokémon" is merely a nickname; the character's true name is unknown. As a researcher, Mr. Pokémon takes pride in the discoveries he makes, although Elm suggests that these are not as exciting as he would make out. The contents of his house, located at the northern end of {{rt|30|Johto}}, suggests that he travels a great deal since he has a large collection of foreign [[Magazines in the Pokémon world|magazines]] and coins. After the [[Embedded Tower]] event, Professor Oak cites Mr. Pokémon's research on {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}}, indicating he may have traveled to [[Hoenn]] in his past. ===Relation to the plot=== [[File:Mr Pokémon GSC.png|thumb|left|Mr. Pokémon's House in [[Generation II]]]] At the beginning of {{game5|Gold|Silver|Crystal|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}, Mr. Pokémon contacts Professor Elm about a [[Pokémon Egg]] he has found. In Generation II, this Egg is notably one of the first Eggs to be found, but in Generation IV (to tie in with {{pkmn|breeding}} in the {{game3|FireRed and LeafGreen|games set before HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}) it is just "another Pokémon Egg". Elm sends {{ga|Ethan}}/{{ga|Kris}}/{{ga|Lyra}} to collect the Egg on his behalf, and later entrusts the player with the Egg. It eventually hatches into {{p|Togepi}} and is revealed to have been given to Mr. Pokémon by the [[Kimono Girl]]s. [[File:HGSS Prerelease Mr Pokemon House.png|thumb|Mr. Pokémon's House in [[Generation IV]]]] Later in the games, in exchange for a [[Red Scale]], obtained from either catching or defeating the [[Red Gyarados]] in the [[Lake of Rage]], Mr. Pokémon will give the player an [[Exp. Share]]. In {{2v2|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}, after obtaining both the [[National Pokédex]] and the [[Kanto first partner Pokémon]] from [[Professor Oak]], Mr. Pokémon will give the player a [[Blue Orb]] in HeartGold or a [[Red Orb]] in SoulSilver.
